## Combo 2292-3234-3293-5413

Color identity: WBG | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite scry 1; Infinite self-mill; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); World Shaper (battlefield); Viscera Seer (battlefield); Trenching Steed (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
Steps: Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
  Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
  When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
  Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
  Repeat
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Color identity: WBG | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite storm count; Near-infinite creature LTB; Exile your library; Near-infinite mill; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite tapped creature tokens
Start: Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis (battlefield); Altar of Dementia (battlefield); Ratadrabik of Urborg (battlefield); Zahur, Glory's Past (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have max speed.
  You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
Steps: Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
  When Hogaak dies, Ratadrabik of Urborg and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
  Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
  Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
  Repeat.
Notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

Produces: Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite colored mana; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite self-mill; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite lifegain; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature
Start: Warren Soultrader (battlefield); Seedship Broodtender (battlefield); Reveillark (graveyard); Boss's Chauffeur (graveyard); Dazzling Angel (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
Steps: Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
  When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
  When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Dazzling Angel and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
  Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
  Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
  Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
  Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
  Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
  When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
  When the Citizens enter, Dazzling Angel triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
  Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
  Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
  Repeat step 12 two additional times.
  Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
  Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  When Reveillark enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
  Repeat.
Notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.
